schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
schemes.purpose: Provides financial assistance to meritorious students from families with limited income to help meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. Fresh scholarships are based on Class 12 board results and scheme rules.

benefits.condition: Graduation level for the first three years, subject to current scheme rules
Postgraduate level, subject to current scheme rules
Fourth and fifth year of eligible five-year/integrated professional courses; technical-course rules may differ

eligibility.class_12_percentile_rule: Must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective board
eligibility.institution: Recognized by AICTE or the relevant regulatory body, as applicable
eligibility.bank_account_rule: Aadhaar-seeded bank account in student's name is specified by the scheme page
exclusions: Correspondence/distance-mode students and diploma-course students are not eligible
Students receiving another scholarship, including certain state scholarship/fee-waiver or reimbursement schemes, are not eligible under the listed scheme rules

documents: Category/caste certificate for reserved-category applicants, if applicable
application_process: Visit the National Scholarship Portal
Complete One Time Registration (OTR) and the portal's required authentication
Submit the scheme application and required details/documents
Follow institute and portal verification instructions
schemes.data_status: Compiled from official scheme portal; verify current academic-year notification before making a final eligibility decision

potential_match_if: regular degree course
annual family income is at or below the listed limit
Class 12 percentile condition is met
institution recognition and other conditions are confirmed
needs_verification_if: another scholarship or fee-waiver benefit is reported
matching_rules.note: This is a screening aid, not an official eligibility decision.

schemes.name: Uttar Pradesh Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement (scheme family)
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department / Backward Classes Welfare Department / Tribal Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh (scheme depends on applicant category)
schemes.purpose: Supports eligible school and post-secondary students in Uttar Pradesh through scholarship and/or fee reimbursement, depending on the applicable scheme, course, category and academic year.

benefits.condition: Amount depends on the specific scheme, course, category, institution and current academic-year rules

eligibility.state_residence: Uttar Pradesh domicile/residence requirements apply according to the specific scheme
eligibility.education_level: Different schemes cover pre-matric and post-matric/dashmottar students
eligibility.category: Rules differ for General, SC, ST, OBC, Minority and other eligible groups depending on the specific scheme
eligibility.income_rule: Income limits differ by scheme/category and academic year; do not apply one shared limit to all applicants
eligibility.academic_requirements: Course, institution, prior qualification and renewal rules vary
eligibility.important_note: This is a family of schemes, not one single uniform scholarship. Match only after selecting the applicable category/course and current notification.

documents: Aadhaar or other identity details as required by the portal
Other documents requested by the applicable portal/application
application_process: Open the official UP Scholarship portal
Choose the applicable pre-matric/post-matric scheme and category
Read the current academic-year instructions
Register/login, complete the form and upload required documents
Submit and track institute/department verification
schemes.data_status: Official portal identified; scheme-specific eligibility, income limits and benefit amounts must be filled from the current notification before automated matching

potential_match_if: state is Uttar Pradesh
student's course/category matches a currently open scheme
needs_verification_if: current-year income limit or benefit amount not confirmed
matching_rules.note: Do not treat this broad scheme family as one rule set.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.purpose: Provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families, subject to scheme conditions and exclusion categories.

benefits.payment_schedule: Three equal installments, subject to eligibility and verification

eligibility.farmer_family: Eligible landholding farmer family, as identified/verified by the State or UT under scheme guidelines
eligibility.land_record_requirement: Landholding and record conditions must be verified under current guidelines
exclusions: Certain current/former constitutional post holders and elected representatives
Certain serving/retired government employees, subject to listed exceptions
Income-tax payers in the last assessment year
Certain professionals practising in registered professions
Other exclusion categories in official guidelines
eligibility.ekyc: eKYC is mandatory for registered beneficiaries

documents: Other identity and registration information requested by the official portal/state verification process
application_process: Use the official PM-KISAN portal
Select New Farmer Registration if applicable
Provide required identity, land and bank details
Complete eKYC and follow state verification/status instructions
schemes.data_status: Compiled from official PM-KISAN portal and PIB; verify current exclusion rules and land-record requirements

potential_match_if: profile indicates farmer and eligible landholding may be present
no known exclusion is reported
matching_rules.note: Occupation as farmer alone is not sufficient to confirm eligibility.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
schemes.department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
schemes.purpose: Supports eligible adult women from poor households in obtaining an LPG connection, subject to current scheme requirements and household verification.

benefits.condition: Connection equipment and installation support are subject to current scheme rules.
Listed among scheme benefits; confirm current application terms with the official portal or distributor.

eligibility.household_condition: No existing LPG connection from an Oil Marketing Company in the same household, subject to current rules.
eligibility.economic_condition: Applicant must meet the prescribed poor-household declaration and applicable category/rules.
eligible_categories_as_listed_on_officia: People residing in islands and river islands
Other poor households meeting the prescribed declaration
eligibility.important_note: Final eligibility depends on household and distributor verification.

documents: Applicant identity details as required by the official process
Ration card or other prescribed family-composition document
Other documents requested by the LPG distributor
application_process: Read the current PMUY application instructions
Apply through the official PMUY portal or an LPG distributor
Complete KYC and provide required household information
Submit the prescribed declaration and supporting details
Follow distributor verification instructions
schemes.data_status: Compiled from official PMUY pages identified in the scheme summary; confirm current requirements before use.

potential_match_if: applicant is a woman aged 18 or above
household does not have an existing LPG connection
poor-household condition may be met
needs_verification_if: current application conditions are not confirmed
matching_rules.note: Do not collect Aadhaar numbers or upload identity documents in the exhibition prototype.

schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
schemes.purpose: Provides support through applicable housing verticals for eligible urban households to construct, purchase or access affordable housing, subject to current guidelines.

Maximum interest subsidy listed for eligible Interest Subsidy Scheme cases; actual benefit depends on loan/property conditions and current rules.

eligibility.house_ownership: Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India, subject to current scheme rules.
eligibility.prior_housing_benefit: Prior housing assistance may affect eligibility; verify the current operational guidelines.
eligibility.note: Vertical-specific conditions and income-band boundary rules apply. Confirm the current vertical before matching.

documents: Identity and household details requested by the official application
Land/ownership documents or home-loan documents where required
Other documents requested by the relevant authority
application_process: Read the current PMAY-U 2.0 guidelines
Check eligibility on the official PMAY-MIS portal
Identify the applicable scheme vertical
Complete the demand/application process and provide required information
Follow verification instructions from the relevant authority
schemes.data_status: Initial prototype entry based on the identified official guidelines; verify current income bands, vertical-specific benefits and conditions.

potential_match_if: applicant is in an eligible urban area
family reports no pucca house in India
household income falls within a relevant band
needs_verification_if: prior housing benefit or house ownership is unclear
